services: NetworkCidr (IPv4 CIDR normalization, containment, mock IP suggestion)
EnvironmentResourceService (structured network zone validation and subnet IP containment)
subnet_rules: Only active leaf network zones can maintain active CIDR subnets.
CIDR blocks are normalized before persistence, and tenant-level duplicate CIDR blocks are rejected.
Gateway IP must be inside the CIDR block when provided.
Manual fulfillment rejects new instance IP addresses outside the selected zone's active subnets.
Mock automated fulfillment uses the selected zone's primary active subnet CIDR to generate addresses.
uat_seed_data: V103 seeds the confirmed reference diagram as P1/P2/P5/P8 root zones, leaf zones, and CIDR subnet data for tenant 1.
V103 preserves V101/V102 default demo zones for compatibility and does not delete or disable existing data.
P2_OFFICE_TERMINAL is created without subnet rows because the diagram only says 20-prefix and does not provide exact CIDR.
